attr.title: Skate 3
attr.desc: Skate 3 native ARM64 port for RK3326 (M9 Pro / ArkOS). Based on the skate-3-rust-engine decompilation. Requires your own Xbox 360 ISO to generate the .pak assets.
attr.inst: Copy your converted .pak files into the skate3/assets/ folder. See README for the full conversion guide.
